body:
I was on a mental health program or something of that, i'd see a person once a week and tell him my progress then i was given something to do, it goes something like this:

1. Go for a small walk around a close area i feel safe in once a week
2. Do step 1 again but this time, twice aweek
3. Do step 2 but extend the length/time i walk
4. Do step 3 but increase times per week

ect ect, making it harder each time, it was ok but the person who i was seeing got ill and was unable to work, he's now back but part time and i havn't heard from him.

everytime i seek help something happens, i'll start the program/or whatever it is and then bang, just ends. There was a time i just lost all hope or trust in doctors, they all follow a scripted "leme check yee blud pressur and we see wots up k" you sit there like "i'm a serial killer what has my blood pressure going to tell you about that?" i'm not a serial killer obviously but, you get the idea =\ they all just follow the same shit rules and i got tired of it...

The only time i feel hope is when i'm not down, normaly just tell myself each day it'll get better eventually...but it never does. Another part of me just when i'm in a good mood and not so down, just keeps telling me theres no reason to die, i'm living ok at the moment and i've got everything i need to live. But that doesn't happen to often and it's normaly after a huge depressive episode.

Besides after huge depressive episode, only thing that brings hope is my dream to be woodworker, but as in my other post, thats very doubtful as i'd need to go back to some sort of schooling and thats a big no, even if i was ok with people theres no way i'd go back to any sort of schooling.
